title: strigosella malacotricha
intro: Strigosella malacotricha, commonly known as African boxwood, is a plant species in the Borage family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include offering health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. The therapeutic actions of S. malacotricha include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
